recognition_rules: Savings requires actual FINANCIALLY_VALIDATED history plus a substantive financial-validation receipt; later operational states cannot bypass it.
Headline savings includes only realized cashable savings with implementation, observed financial effect and preserved operational guardrails.
Recovery, avoidance, capacity and validated opportunities remain separate classes; cross-class totals are prohibited.
The same cost-object and period cannot recur in another class or scenario. Split into evidenced disjoint cost objects before recognition.
Eliminate matched internal charges and credits once, retaining provider external cost and source residual cost.
Exclude already embedded proposals, approved baseline reforms and prior closures from newly attributable project benefits.
Unknown totals are null, not a measured zero; empty recognized coverage is not zero waste or a completed portfolio.
Restricted evidence references must point to approved storage; no underlying restricted records in public Git.

totals_reconciliation_receipt.limitations: Arithmetic validator verifies structure and evidence-reference presence only; it cannot authenticate restricted records or replace independent substantive review.
